targets.name: Docker 28.5.2+dfsg4 on Kali GNU/Linux Rolling, runc 1.3.6+ds1

findings.title: User namespace remapping disabled
findings.message: Neither userns-remap nor rootless mode is enabled
findings.fix: Enable userns-remap in daemon.json or run Docker rootless, so root in a container is not root on the host.

findings.title: Containers on the default bridge can talk to each other
findings.message: Containers on the default bridge can talk to each other
findings.fix: Set "icc": false in daemon.json, or move containers onto user-defined networks.

findings.title: Runs as root
findings.fix: Add a non-root USER to the Dockerfile, or run with --user 1000:1000.

findings.title: Default capabilities kept
findings.message: Runs with Docker's default capability set
findings.fix: Use --cap-drop ALL and add back only the capabilities the workload needs.

findings.title: Privilege escalation not blocked
findings.message: no-new-privileges is not set, so setuid binaries can raise privileges
findings.fix: Run with --security-opt no-new-privileges:true, or set "no-new-privileges": true in daemon.json.

findings.title: Writable root filesystem
findings.fix: Run with --read-only and mount a tmpfs for the paths that need writes, like /tmp.

findings.title: No memory limit
findings.fix: Set --memory (mem_limit or deploy.resources.limits.memory in Compose).

findings.title: No CPU limit
findings.fix: Set --cpus (cpus or deploy.resources.limits.cpus in Compose).

findings.title: No PID limit
findings.fix: Set --pids-limit so a fork bomb can't take down the host.

findings.title: No healthcheck
findings.fix: Add a HEALTHCHECK so a hung process gets noticed and restarted.

findings.title: Attached to the default bridge network
findings.message: Attached to the default bridge network
findings.fix: Put the container on a user-defined network so unrelated containers can't reach it.

findings.title: Dangerous capability added
findings.message: CAP_SYS_ADMIN added with seccomp and AppArmor turned off
findings.fix: Remove the capability. Most workloads run fine with --cap-drop ALL plus one or two specific additions.

findings.title: Sensitive host path mounted
findings.fix: Mount only the specific files or directories the container needs, read-only where possible.

findings.title: Seccomp disabled
findings.fix: Remove seccomp=unconfined. If a syscall gets blocked, use a custom profile that allows just that syscall.

findings.title: AppArmor disabled
findings.fix: Remove apparmor=unconfined, or write a profile tailored to the workload.

findings.title: SELinux separation disabled
findings.fix: Remove label=disable and relabel volumes with :z or :Z instead.

findings.title: Host namespace shared
findings.fix: Drop the host namespace flag. Publish ports or mount volumes for whatever the container needs from the host.

findings.title: Secret in image history
findings.message: Build argument NPM_TOKEN looks like a credential
findings.fix: Anyone who can pull the image can read its history. Rebuild without the secret (RUN --mount=type=secret for build-time secrets) and rotate the credential.

findings.title: Secret in image history

findings.fix: Anyone who can pull the image can read its history. Rebuild without the secret (RUN --mount=type=secret for build-time secrets) and rotate the credential.
